notes.aoi_shapefile: Path to shapefile. If it has multiple features, a separate mosaic will be created for each one.
notes.output_folder: Folder where GDB and mosaic datasets will be saved.
notes.area_name: Prefix added to all output mosaic names (e.g. 'KSA' produces KSA_Feature_1, KSA_Field_A). Leave empty for no prefix.
notes.mrf_cache_folder: Local folder for MRF tile cache. Must exist and have sufficient disk space.
notes.name_field: Optional: field in shapefile to use as mosaic name (e.g. 'FieldName'). Leave empty to use feature index (Feature_1, Feature_2, ...).
notes.best_scene_only: If true, keeps only the best scene (lowest cloud cover, most recent tiebreaker) per Sentinel-2 tile. Result is a non-overlapping mosaic of cloudless tiles.
notes.months: Optional: list of month numbers to include (e.g. [6,7,8] for June-August only). Leave empty [] to include all months in the date range.
